title: Wire the declared-versus-touched check at build exit, or delete internal/scopedelta
summary: From the inbox architecture review (N5). Design doc §5.9 records the partition gap: a builder's edits outside its item's declared files (cycle 1718 edited a doc that then conflicted with 1719; every size-ratchet lane edits an undeclared offenders.json). internal/scopedelta (ADR-0087/0088) classifies exactly this, including ClassCrossLane, and has no importer.
acceptance: Either the build exit reports, with a coded signal, every changed path outside the declared scope classified by scopedelta (a path in a sibling lane's declared scope flagged), with a wiring proof
Or the package is deleted with its tests and ADR-0087/0088 are amended
